name: proto-blocks/oit-resources
title: OIT Resources
description: Resources library section. Pulls items from the Resources CPT (cover = featured image, eyebrow = first Resource Type term, title = post title, link = permalink), then a conversion callout bar at the bottom with editable headline + CTA. Sits on the light-grey to white background gradient.

limit.label: Max resources
limit.help: How many resources to display, newest first.

showCta.label: Show CTA bar
showCta.help: Off: hide the dark conversion callout at the bottom.
